scope: Post-run execution-path identity reconciliation only. No forecast read, RTTOV execution, or recomputation of the six costs. This is not a pre-launch provenance capture.

baseline_saved_result.interpretation: The main six-case baseline RTTOV call and cost were recorded before the local profile-H finite-difference evaluations began. The per-profile hashes are the values saved in RESULT.json at that call.

baseline_output_directory_after_old_runn.reason: The recorded runner reused run_baseline for four local H finite-difference calls; qv plus was the final call, so this directory now holds that final perturbed Q input. The actual baseline BT/cost and baseline profile hashes were already saved in RESULT.json before those overwrites. Do not treat the present q.txt in this directory as the baseline profile.

runner_identity.snapshot_method: Reconstructed after the run by reversing only the subsequent local-H path-isolation diff; digest exactly matches the runner SHA preserved in RESULT.json.
runner_identity.future_path_fix: The base, T-/T+, and qv-/qv+ local profile-H RTTOV calls each write to a fresh child case directory. The six main scenario case directories are no longer reused by those derivative calls.

source_and_build_limit: M_source_identity.json remains the after-run tracked KDM source pin cross-checked with Red at the stated git revision. The historical runner snapshot is checksum-matched, but this does not create a pre-launch source capture or a new RTTOV source-to-binary build attestation.
